整理时，这段时间的聊天原话（双方，太长的会截短）会交给整理记忆的 AI。你说的话: When organizing, the chat text from that period (both sides, long messages shortened) is sent to the organizing AI. Your own words count most; the AI's words only record what you talked about, or count when you agree.
压缩包里有说明、整理好的「记忆.md」、完整的记忆库和全部聊天记录（单独一个文件: The zip contains a guide, a tidy “memory.md”, the full memory library and all your chats (in their own folder). Passwords, keys, phone and ID numbers are replaced with “[hidden]” on export. Unzip it on another computer and drag the folder to any agent — after reading the guide it will know you. No API keys or raw window records. The zip has no password, so keep it safe.
压缩包会连同你和 AI 的全部聊天记录一起导出。: The zip will include your full chat history with the AI.
密码、密钥、手机号、证件号、银行卡这类内容会换成「[已隐藏]」，但规则不是万能的: Passwords, keys, phone, ID and bank card numbers are replaced with “[hidden]”, but the rules aren't perfect: other private details (names, addresses you mentioned) stay as they are.
压缩包没有密码，拿到它的人能看到关于你的全部记忆。请自己保管好，不要随便发给别人: The zip has no password: anyone who gets it can read everything about you. Keep it safe and don't hand it out casually.
「导出记忆库」会生成一个压缩包（连同聊天记录，密码之类的会换成「[已隐藏]」）。: “Export memory library” makes a zip (with chat history; passwords and the like become “[hidden]”). Unzip it on another computer and drag the folder to any agent — after reading the guide it will know you.
手机上装好 AwyRead 并配对后，它会在你和电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi 时，把: Once AwyRead is installed on your phone and paired, it sends app usage time, steps, heart rate and sleep here, encrypted, whenever the phone and this computer are on the same Wi-Fi. They are organized into memories together with your computer activity. When this is on, the computer listens on your home network for your phone (other devices have no pairing key and cannot send anything). The first time, Windows may ask whether to allow network access: choose “Private networks” and allow.
没查到（电脑可能没连网）: Not found (the computer may be offline)
在手机 AwyRead 的「电脑」里填这个配对码。{m} 分钟内有效，只能用一次: Enter this pairing code under “Computer” in AwyRead on your phone. Valid for {m} min, one use only.
配对码只用来让手机和电脑互相认出对方，不会在网络上传。: The pairing code only lets the phone and computer recognize each other. It is never sent over the network.
（预览演示）这里会打开接收、生成配对码或取消配对: (Preview) This would turn receiving on, create a pairing code or unpair
取消后它传来的数据电脑不再收。已经收到的数据和整理出的记忆不受影响。以后想用，在: This computer will stop accepting data from it. Data already received and memories already organized are kept. To use it again, just pair again from the phone.
复制失败，请照着输入: Could not copy. Please type it in instead.
手机找不到电脑时，把这个地址填到手机 AwyRead 的「电脑地址」里。只显示真: If your phone cannot find this computer, enter this address in “Computer address” in AwyRead on the phone. Only real Wi-Fi / wired adapters are shown; VPN, virtual network and virtual machine adapters are not used for pairing.
填了地址还是连不上：公司、学校这类 Wi-Fi 常常不让连在上面的设备互相连接，: Still can’t connect with the address? Workplace and school Wi-Fi often stops devices on it from reaching each other. Pair and transfer on your home Wi-Fi instead, or connect the phone to this computer’s Mobile hotspot.
如果你在「设置 → 手机」里打开接收并配对了手机端 AwyRead，还会收到手机: If you turn on receiving in Settings → Phone and pair the AwyRead phone app, it also receives data from your phone: how long you used each app, screen-on time, and health data such as steps, heart rate and sleep. While this is on, the computer waits on your local network (the same Wi-Fi) for the phone; devices without the pairing key can’t send anything. Off by default.
我会一直陪着你：记下你在电脑和手机上做了什么，定时整理成记忆，聊天时像老朋友一样: I’ll always be with you: I note what you do on your computer and phone, organize it into memories on a schedule, and know you like an old friend when we chat.
配对了手机的话：每个 App 用了多久、亮屏时间、步数、心率、睡眠: With a paired phone: how long you used each app, screen-on time, steps, heart rate, sleep
手机上装了 AwyRead 的话，它会在和电脑连同一个 Wi-Fi 时，把应用使: With AwyRead installed on your phone, app usage time, steps, heart rate and sleep are sent here encrypted whenever the phone and computer share a Wi-Fi network, and organized into memories too. Off by default; skip this if you don’t need it.
（预览演示）这里会打开接收手机数据: (Preview) This would turn on receiving phone data
已打开。之后在「设置 → 手机」里点「配对新手机」，把配对码填到手机上: Turned on. Next, click “Pair a new phone” in Settings → Phone and enter the code on your phone
